'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Abyei border conflict (2022–present)|Abyei border conflict]]
**Thirty-seven people are killed during fights over a suspected [[land]] [[feud]] in the disputed region of [[Abyei]] on the border between [[South Sudan]] and [[Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-sudan-abyei-land-dispute-cc6d77f2eec8f3e0e8b8603aea5738b0 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[66th Annual Grammy Awards]]
** [[Miley Cyrus]] wins [[Grammy Award for Record of the Year|Record of the Year]], her first [[Grammy Awards|Grammy Award]], for her 2023 single "[[Flowers (Miley Cyrus song)|Flowers]]". [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/miley-cyrus-wins-first-grammy-pop-solo-performance-flowers/ (CBS News)]
** [[Taylor Swift]] wins [[Grammy Award for Album of the Year|Album of the Year]] for ''[[Midnights (album)|Midnights]]'', becoming the first artist to win the award four times. She also announces the release of a new album, ''[[The Tortured Poets Department]]'', on April 19, 2024. [https://variety.com/2024/music/news/taylor-swift-new-album-the-tortured-poets-department-1235897622/ (''Variety'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Chile wildfires]]
**The death toll from major wildfires in [[Valparaíso]], [[Chile]], increases to at least 112 people, with between 3,000 and 6,000 houses damaged in the fires. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-68196048 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Salvadoran general election]]
**[[Salvadorans]] vote to elect the [[President of El Salvador|president]], [[Vice President of El Salvador|vice president]], and [[Legislative Assembly of El Salvador|Legislative Assembly]]. With over 80% of the popular vote, [[Nayib Bukele]] wins re-election in a first-round landslide. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-68196826 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-president-bukele-poised-another-landslide-voters-head-polls-2024-02-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[President of Namibia]] [[Hage Geingob]] dies at the age of 82, and is succeeded by [[Vice-President of Namibia|Vice-President]] [[Nangolo Mbumba]] on an acting basis. [https://www.namibian.com.na/president-hage-geingob-is-dead/ (''The Namibian'')]
